source: Kickoff Workflow Mapping Sprint, six group boards (3 CM, 3 Ops), extracted 12 Sep 2026. Items marked confirm are handwriting or terms still to verify.
zonesNote: zone 'own-desk' means the seat's own desk. Other zone ids come from vault.sample/office/zones.json.
